map.：例（MCV=72、铁蛋白=8、血清铁=6、TIBC=75、B12=200、叶酸: : Example (MCV=72, ferritin=8, serum iron=6, TIBC=75, B12=200, folate=10, LDH=250, bilirubin=12, haptoglobin=1.0, reticulocytes=1.2): TSAT=6/75×100=8% (<15); the iron deficiency items sum to 3(MCV)+4(ferritin<15)+2(ferritin<30)+3(TSAT)+2(TIBC)=14 points; megaloblastic=0 and hemolytic=0. The total of 14 points means a strong tendency toward iron deficiency anemia.
map.：加权评分法：对缺铁性（MCV↓、铁蛋白<15 或 <30、转铁蛋白饱和度 TS: : Weighted scoring: accumulate the weights for iron deficiency (MCV↓, ferritin<15 or <30, transferrin saturation TSAT<15%, TIBC↑), megaloblastic (MCV>100, B12<148 pmol/L, folate<7 nmol/L, LDH>500), and hemolytic (reticulocytes>2%, LDH>400, bilirubin>20, haptoglobin<0.3) separately, then rank by the total score to give the tendency.
